opportunities.name: Dinner plan: restaurant + recipe note
opportunities.description: Search a cuisine+area for a restaurant on the restaurant site, find a matching recipe on Allrecipes, and save a combined 'Dinner: out at X or cook Y' note.
steps: Search the restaurant site for the cuisine and area
Open the top restaurant's details and read rating, price, area
Search Allrecipes for the dish and open the top recipe
Add a note: Dinner: out at <restaurant> (<rating>, <price>, <area>) or cook <recipe> (<time>)

opportunities.name: Stopover city: Wikipedia + Booking hotel + note
opportunities.description: Look up a city on Wikipedia, search Booking.com for a one-night stay on a given Saturday, and save a stopover note with hotel, price, sight and population.
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia for sights and population
Enter the city as the Booking destination and choose the suggestion
Select the check-in Saturday and check-out Sunday dates
Search and open the top hotel to get its price

opportunities.name: Call email: local time + weather
opportunities.description: For a city, check current time on timeanddate and the 10-day weather, then compose an email to family about a call with a relative including time difference and forecast.
steps: Search the city on timeanddate and open its page for current time and offset
Search the city on the weather site and open the 10 Day forecast
Compose email to family with subject 'Call with <person> on <day>'
Write body with local time, offset from Lille and forecast
